name: encrust
description: Prepare a 3D model for an MSLA resin printer: orient, hollow, drain, support, check and write the printer file.
long_description: Encrust is an offline resin slicer. This extension lets Claude drive it on your computer: every tool runs the encrust command line on your own files, profiles and printers on your network. Exposure comes from your own resin profiles only.

tools.name: list_profiles
tools.description: The printers, your resins and the support profiles

tools.name: inspect_model
tools.description: What a model file is and what is wrong with it

tools.name: start_job
tools.description: Starts preparing a model for a printer and resin

tools.name: set_pose
tools.description: Orients the model, by the search or a turn

tools.name: set_hollow
tools.description: Hollows the model, with or without infill

tools.name: set_drains
tools.description: Drills drain holes into the cavity

tools.name: set_supports
tools.description: Builds the supports the model stands on

tools.name: check
tools.description: Checks a revision as it would print

tools.name: render
tools.description: Draws the prepared plate from each side, problems marked

tools.name: send_to_printer
tools.description: Sends a written file to a printer on your network
